name: BMW R1100GS
engine: 1085 cc oil/air-cooled boxer twin, fuel injected, shaft drive
intro: The first oilhead GS. Owners point to the final drive bearing, the front brake hose and the clutch arm.

add.title: Lube the drive splines
add.instructions: Pull the rear drive and clean and grease the shaft splines with a moly paste. Look for oil in the swingarm.
add.reason: Dry splines wear and fail. Most owners forget to grease them.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.

known.title: Common issues
known.what: Owners report the final drive bearing, the front master cylinder brake hose and the clutch actuator arm as common issues.
